subject: Post-call: Stakeholder mapping & next steps - Finovate
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-02-20T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Stakeholder mapping & next steps - Finovate

Team — quick post-call recap from my discovery with Elena/Devon at Finovate (call 2/20):

Key notes:
- Use case: real-time personalized responses for customer support and automated claim triage. Core wins are reduced handle time and faster triage for low-complexity claims.
- Decision criteria: latency SLA, cost per 1M tokens, SOC2 + pen test evidence, and integration effort with their existing message bus.
- Timeline: procurement review + legal expected in 2-3 weeks; target pilot decision by end of March.

Stakeholder map (as surfaced on call):
1) Elena Morales — Head of Product (Champion) — interested in ROI and product fit; owns pilot success criteria.
2) Devon Price — VP of Eng (Technical evaluator) — cares about latency, infra, and integration effort.
3) Miriam Soto (Procurement) — expects pricing band and standard terms; will request security pack.
4) Jae Park (Legal) — standard SLAs, IP/data residency questions.
5) Finance lead (TBD) — will sign off on spend.

Asks / next steps (owners):
- Neha: can you pull together SOC 2 summary + pen test summary and the standard security packet? Need by next Tue (2/23).
- Rachel: can you lead a procurement sync and share our pricing band (initial) and typical PO timeline?
- Priyom: can you draft a 1-page champion talk track and 3-slide ROI highlights for Elena?
- Monica: please confirm which infra options (hosted vs dedicated) map to their latency/cost ask; add quick notes on recommended pilot config.

Attachments: Finovate-stakeholder-map.pdf, RIP-ROI-model.xlsx (working model).

I'll assemble a short enablement email to Elena that summarizes our alignment after we have the security packet and pricing. Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Date: 2027-02-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Stakeholder mapping & next steps - Finovate

Looping in some quick champion enablement bullets I can turn into a 1-pager/slides tonight. Attached: champion-talk-track.docx (draft).

Champion talk track (TL;DR):
- Topline: Move faster on claims resolution: pilot shows ~30% reduction in handle time for low-complexity claims -> direct ops savings + better CSAT.
- ROI ask: 3-month pilot, measure handle-time reduction and deflected tickets; modeled payback < 6 months at 20k monthly interactions (see RIP-ROI-model.xlsx).
- How to win execs: focus on measurable ops savings, predictable pilot cost, and low integration lift (we'll provide a reference integration checklist).
- Objection prep: latency — we can demo p95 under their median payload and show dedicated options if required; security — deliver SOC2 + pen-test summary; pricing — propose pilot band $X–$Y (exact numbers in the model).

I'll finalize the 1-pager and 3 slides by EOD and send to Marissa for review.

-Priyom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@finovate.com>, Devon Price <devon.price@finovate.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-02-21T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Stakeholder mapping & next steps - Finovate

Elena/Devon — thanks again for the time yesterday. Quick update on our side and proposed next steps: 

What we heard (confirming):
- Pilot goals: reduce handle time and automate triage for low-complexity claims; measure CSAT and cost per interaction.
- Key asks: security evidence (SOC2/pen test), integration effort estimate, and clear pilot pricing.

Next steps (we propose):
1) Security packet: Neha will send SOC2 summary + pen-test exec summary by Tue 2/23.
2) Procurement sync: Rachel will reach out to Miriam to coordinate a short procurement call next week (she'll include pricing band and PO timeline).
3) Champion enablement: we'll send a 1-page talk track + 3-slide ROI summary for you to use with execs — expect this by EOD 2/21.
4) Technical follow-up: Monica and Devon (if helpful) can do a short tech session on integration options; propose Wed 2/24 or Thu 2/25.

Attachments we'll share internally (and send over on request): Finovate-stakeholder-map.pdf, RIP-ROI-model.xlsx, champion-talk-track.docx (draft).

Can you confirm whether Miriam (procurement) and Jae (legal) should be on the procurement sync, or if you'd prefer to introduce us after we send the security packet? Also, if there are any special compliance/regulatory notes (KMS/HSM), flag those and Neha will include the extra doc.

If that plan looks good, I'll mark items on our side as owners and follow up with scheduled invites.

Thanks — looking forward to running the pilot with you.

--
